label: Possible existence-causation at a…: PossibleCauseAt m v x y means that some u accessible from v…
term: possible existence-causation at a world in the modal-degree profile
definition: PossibleCauseAt m v x y means that some u accessible from v has the supplied actual causal edge m.Causes u x y. The same rigid x and y occur in the possibility witness and current-world degree comparison. This predicate does not assert m.Causes v x y, a common witness world for several effects, or presence of either relatum unless separately guarded. The supplied relation is interpreted as existence-causation in this reading; causal soundness, sufficiency and identification with the separate CausesIn perfection relation are not built into the definition.
note: Existing Ontic/accessibility semantics with an explicitly selected existential-causation reading. The conditional source7 reading is restricted to relata present at its CURRENT evaluation world; the possibility witness does not move the comparison to u. Formal controls distinguish causal possibility from actual exercise. No new source claim about actual causal exercise or complete metaphysical possibility is encoded by this definition.
